cues: {{0|Han}}, old buddy, do you read me?
Loud and clear, kid. What's up?
I finished my circle. I don't pick up any life readings.
There isn't enough life on this ice cube to fill a space cruiser.
The sensors are placed. I'm going back.
There's a meteorite that hit the ground near here.
I want to check it out. It won't take long.
Steady, girl. What's the matter? You smell something?
All right. Don't lose your temper.
I'll come right back and give you a hand.
No sign of life out there, General. The sensors are in place.
You'll know if anything comes around.
No. He's checking out a meteorite that hit near him.
With all the meteor activity, it's gonna be difficult to spot approaching ships.
General, I gotta leave. I can't stay anymore.
There's a price on my head.
If I don't pay off Jabba the Hutt, I'm a dead man.
A death mark's not an easy thing to live with.
You're a good fighter, Solo. I hate to lose you.
Well, Your Highness, guess this is it.
Don't get all mushy on me. So long, Princess.
I thought you had decided to stay.
The bounty hunter we ran into in Ord Mantell changed my mind.
I don't know what you're talking about.
What precisely am I supposed to know?
Come on. You want me to stay because of the way you feel about me.
Yes. You're a great help to us. You're a natural leader.
Am I? Then why are you following me?
Afraid I'd leave without giving you a good-bye kiss?
I'd just as soon kiss a Wookiee.
You could use a good kiss!
Don't blame me. I didn't ask you to turn on the thermal heater.
I merely commented that it was freezing in the princess's chamber.
How we're going to dry her clothes I really don't know.
Why did you take this apart now? I'm trying to get us out of here.
Put them back together right now.
Princess {{3|Leia}}'s been trying to get you on the communicator.
I turned it off. I don't want to talk to her.
Princess {{3|Leia}} is wondering about Master {{1|Luke}}. He hasn't come back.
She doesn't know where he is.
I don't know where he is.
What do you mean, nobody knows?
Do you know where Commander Skywalker is?
I haven't seen him. It's possible he came in the south entrance.
It's possible? Why don't you go find out?
Excuse me, sir. Might I inquire what's going on?
Come along, R2. Let's find Princess {{3|Leia}}.
Between ourselves, I think Master {{1|Luke}} is in considerable danger.
Commander Skywalker hasn't come in the south entrance.
Maybe he forgot to check in.
Not likely. Are the speeders ready?
Not yet. We're having trouble adapting them to the cold.
We'll have to go out on tauntauns.
That's right, and my friend's out in it.
Your tauntaun will freeze before you reach the first marker.
Then I'll see you in hell.
You must come along now, R2.
There's really nothing more we can do.
And my joints are freezing up.
Don't say things like that. Of course we'll see Master {{1|Luke}} again.
And he'll be quite all right. You'll see.
Stupid little short circuit. He'll be quite all right.
Sir, all the patrols are in. Still no...
Still no contact from Skywalker or Solo.
Mistress {{3|Leia}}, R2 says he's been quite unable to pick up any signals...
although he admits that his own range is far too weak to abandon all hope.
Your Highness, there's nothing more we can do tonight.
The shield doors must be closed.
R2 says the chances of survival are 725-to-1.
Actually, R2 has been known to make mistakes...
Don't worry about Master {{1|Luke}}. I'm sure he'll be all right.
He's quite clever, you know, for a human being.
You will go to the Dagobah system.
the Jedi master who instructed me.
Don't do this, {{1|Luke}}. Give me a sign here.
but it'll keep you warm till I get the shelter up.
Not much, but it could be a life-form.
Good morning. Nice of you guys to drop by.
Echo Base, this is Rogue Two.
I've found them. Repeat. I've found them.
Master {{1|Luke}}, sir, it's so good to see you fully functional again.
How ya feelin', kid? You don't look so bad to me.
You look strong enough to pull the ears off a gundark.
That's two you owe me, junior.
looks like you managed to keep me around for a little while longer.
I had nothing to do with it.
General {{10|Rieekan}} thinks it's dangerous for any ships to leave...
until we've activated the energy field.
I think you just can't bear to let a gorgeous guy like me out of your sight.
I don't know where you get your delusions, laser brain.
but you didn't see us alone in the south passage.
She expressed her true feelings for me.
I must have hit close to the mark to get her riled up like that, huh, kid?
I guess you don't know everything about women yet.
Headquarters personnel, report to command center.
Headquarters personnel, report to command center.
We picked up something outside Zone 12 moving east.
It couldn't be one of those creatures.
Could be one of our speeders.
There's something very weak coming through.
Sir, I am fluent in six million forms of communication.
This signal is not used by the Alliance. It could be an imperial code.
It isn't friendly. Chewie, let's check it out.
I'm afraid there's not much left.
{{26|Droid}} of some kind. I didn't hit it that hard.
Must have had a self-destruct. - An imperial probe {{26|droid}}.
It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.
I think we've got something, sir. The report is only a fragment...
from a probe {{26|droid}} in the Hoth system, but it's the best lead we've had.
We have thousands of probe droids searching the galaxy.
It could mean anything. If we followed up every lead...
But, sir, the Hoth system is supposed to be devoid of human forms.
That's it. The rebels are there.
My lord, there are so many uncharted settlements.
And I'm sure Skywalker is with them.
Set your course for the Hoth system.
Groups Seven and 10 will stay behind to fly the speeders.
As soon as each transport is loaded...
evacuation control will give clearance for launch.
Turn it off! Turn it off!
Sir, it will take quite a while to evacuate the T-47s.
Forget the heavy equipment. There's time to get small modules on the transports.
Chewie, take care of yourself, okay?
There's gotta be a reason for it. Check it at the other end.
General, there's a fleet of Stardestroyers...
coming out of hyperspace in Sector Four.
Reroute all power to the energy shield.
We gotta hold them till all transports are away.
The fleet has moved out of light speed.
ComScan has detected an energy field...
protecting an area of the sixth planet of the Hoth system.
The field is strong enough to deflect any bombardment.
The rebels are alerted to our presence.
Admiral {{13|Ozzel}} came out of light speed too close to the system.
He is as clumsy as he is stupid.
General, prepare your troops for a surface attack.
The fleet has moved out of light speed, and we're preparing to...
You have failed me for the last time, Admiral.
Make ready to land our troops beyond their energy field...
and deploy the fleet so that nothing gets off the system.
You are in command now, Admiral {{7|Piett}}.
All troop carriers will assemble at the north entrance.
The heavy transport ships will leave as soon as they're loaded.
Only two fighter escorts per ship.
The energy shield can only be opened for a short time...
so you'll have to stay very close to your transports.
The ion cannon will fire several shots...
to make sure that any enemy ships will be out of your flight path.
When you've gotten past the energy shield...
proceed directly to the rendezvous point.
Everybody to your stations. Let's go.
Their primary target will be the power generators.
Sir, {{25|rebel}} ships are coming into our sector.
Good. Our first catch of the day.
Just like new, Dak. How about you?
Right now I feel I could take on the whole Empire myself.
Echo Station 3-T8. We've spotted imperial walkers.
Imperial walkers on the north ridge.
Echo Station 57, we're on our way.
All right, boys, keep tight now.
{{1|Luke}}, I have no approach vector. I'm not set.
That armor's too strong for blasters.
Rogue Group, use your harpoons and tow cables.
Go for the legs. It might be our only chance.
{{1|Luke}}, we've got a malfunction in fire control.
I'll have to cut in the auxiliary.
Hang on, Dak. Get ready to fire that tow cable.
Yes, Lord {{5|Vader}}. I've reached the main power generators.
The shield will be down in moments. You may start your landing.
{{15|Wedge}}, I've lost my gunner. You'll have to make this shot.
Set your harpoon. Follow me on the next pass.
I don't think we can protect two transports at a time.
It's risky, but we can't hold out much longer.
This one goes there, that one goes there. Right?
R2, you take good care of Master {{1|Luke}} now, understand?
And do take good care of yourself.
All troops will debark for ground assault.
Prepare to target the main generator.
Rogue Two, are you all right?
Yeah. I'm with you, Rogue Leader.
Set harpoon. I'll cover for you.
Stay tight and low. This is it!
Heard the command center had been hit.
You've got your clearance to leave.
Don't worry. I'll leave. First I'm gonna get you to your ship.
Your Highness, we must take this last transport. It's our only hope.
Send all troops in Sector 12 to the south slope to protect the fighters.
Imperial troops have entered the base.
Transport, this is Solo. Take off. I can't get to you.
I'll get her out on the Falcon. Come on.
Where are you going? Come back!
Hurry up, goldenrod! You're gonna be a permanent resident.
Would it help if I got out and pushed?
Sir, might I suggest that you...
This bucket of bolts will never get past that blockade.
This baby's got a few surprises left in her.
Switch over. Let's hope we don't have a burnout.
Someday you'll be wrong. I hope I'm there to see it.
Good luck, {{1|Luke}}. See you at the rendezvous.
Don't worry, R2. We're going. We're going.
There's nothing wrong, R2. I'm just setting a new course.
We're not gonna regroup with the others. We're going to the Dagobah system.
That's all right. I'd like to keep it on manual control for a while.
Stardestroyers, two of 'em coming right at us.
Shut him up or shut him down!
Great. Well, we can still outmaneuver them.
Prepare to jump to light speed.
I noticed earlier the hyperdrive motivator has been damaged.
It's impossible to go to light speed.
That's not it. Bring me the hydrospanner.
I don't know how we're gonna get out of this one.
That wasn't a laser blast. Something hit us.
You're not actually going into an asteroid field?
They'd be crazy to follow us, wouldn't they?
You don't have to do this to impress me.
Sir, the possibility of successfully navigating an asteroid field...
is approximately 3,720-to-1. - Never tell me the odds.
You said you wanted to be around when I made a mistake. This could be it.
We're gonna get pulverized if we stay out here much longer.
I'm going closer to one of the big ones.
This is suicide! There's nowhere to go.
Excuse me, ma'am, but where are we going?
I hope you know what you're doing.
No, I'm not gonna change my mind about this.
I'm not picking up any cities or technology.
Yes. I'm sure it's perfectly safe for droids.
All the scopes are dead. I can't see a thing.
Just hang on. I'm gonna start the landing cycle.
No, R2, you stay put. I'll have a look around.
Are you all right? Come on.
You were lucky to get out of there.
If you're saying coming here was a bad idea...
I'm beginning to agree with ya.
R2, what are we doing here?
something out of a dream or...
Our ships have sighted the Millennium Falcon, lord...
but it has entered an asteroid field, and we cannot risk...
Asteroids do not concern me, Admiral.
I want that ship, not excuses.
I'm gonna shut down everything but the emergency power systems.
Sir, I'm almost afraid to ask, but does that include shutting me down too?
No. I need you to talk to the Falcon...
find out what's wrong with the hyperdrive.
Sir, it's quite possible this asteroid is not entirely stable.
I'm glad you're here to tell us these things.
Chewie, take the professor in the back and plug him into the hyperdrive.
Sometimes I just don't understand human behavior.
After all, I'm only trying to do my job.
{{25|Captain}}, being held by you isn't quite enough to get me excited.
I haven't got time for anything else.
Put that in there. There you go.
Now all I gotta do is find this {{4|Yoda}}...
It's really a strange place to find a Jedi master.
This place gives me the creeps.
there's something familiar about this place.
Away put your weapon. I mean you no harm.
I am wondering, why are you here?
Found someone you have, I would say.
I'm looking for a great warrior.
How you get so big eating food of this kind?
Listen, friend, we didn't mean to land in that puddle.
If we could get our ship out, we would. But we can't.
Aw, cannot get your ship out.
Hey, you could have broken this.
Mine, or I will help you not.
I don't want your help. I want my lamp back.
I'm gonna need it to get out of this slimy mudhole.
Mudhole? Slimy? My home this is.
Will you move along, little fella? We got a lot of work to do.
Stay and help you I will. Find your friend.
I'm not looking for a friend. I'm looking for a Jedi master.
Take you to him I will.
Yes, yes, but now we must eat.
stay and watch after the camp.
Where is R2 when I need him?
Sir, I don't know where your ship learned to communicate...
but it has the most peculiar dialect.
I believe it says the power coupling on the negative axis has been polarized.
I'm afraid you'll have to replace it.
Well, of course I'll have to replace it.
I think we better replace the negative power coupling.
Hey, Your Worship, I'm only trying to help.
Would you please stop calling me that?
You make it so difficult sometimes.
You could be a little nicer though.
Admit it. Sometimes you think I'm all right.
when you aren't acting like a scoundrel.
I like the sound of that.
Stop that. My hands are dirty.
My hands are dirty too. What are you afraid of?
You like me because I'm a scoundrel.
There aren't enough scoundrels in your life.
I happen to like nice men.
I've isolated the reverse power flux coupling.
That, Lord {{5|Vader}}, was the last time they appeared in any of our scopes.
Considering the damage we've sustained, they must have been destroyed.
I want every ship available to sweep the asteroid field until they are found.
The {{16|emperor}} commands you to make contact with him.
Move the ship out of the asteroid field...
so that we can send a clear transmission.
What is thy bidding, my master?
There is a great disturbance in the Force.
the young {{25|rebel}} who destroyed the Death Star.
I have no doubt this boy...
is the offspring of Anakin Skywalker.
You will know it to be true.
Obi-Wan can no longer help him.
The Force is strong with him.
The son of Skywalker must not become a Jedi.
he would become a powerful ally.
He would be a great asset.
He will join us or die, master.
I'm sure it's delicious. I just don't understand why we can't see {{4|Yoda}} now.
Patience. For the Jedi, it is time to eat as well.
How far away is {{4|Yoda}}? Will it take us long to get there?
Patience. Soon you will be with him.
Mostly 'cause of my father, I guess.
How could you know my father? You don't even know who I am.
I don't even know what I'm doing here. We're wasting our time!
Was I any different when you taught me?
I can be a Jedi. {{9|Ben}}, tell him I'm...
Ready, are you? What know you ready?
For 800 years have I trained Jedi.
My own counsel will I keep on who is to be trained.
A Jedi must have the deepest commitment...
This one a long time have I watched.
All his life has he looked away...
to the future, to the horizon.
Never his mind on where he was...
A Jedi craves not these things.
So was I, if you remember.
Yes, too old to begin the training.
Will he finish what he begins?
Sir, if I may venture an opinion...
I'm not interested in your opinion.
I just got this bucket together. I won't let it get torn apart.
I think it might be better if I stay behind and guard the ship.
There's an awful lot of moisture in here.
I don't know. I have a bad feeling about this.
It's all right. It's all right.
Yeah, that's what I thought... mynock.
Chewie, check the rest of the ship and make sure there are no more attached...
Go inside. We'll clean them off if there are any more.
Go away! Go away, beastly thing! Shoo!
Chewie, let's get out of here!
The Empire is still out there!
No time to discuss this in committee!
You can't make the jump to light speed in this asteroid field.
Sit down, sweetheart. We're taking off.
A Jedi's strength flows from the Force.
But beware of the dark side. Anger, fear, aggression...
The dark side of the Force are they.
Easily they flow, quick to join you in a fight.
If once you start down the dark path...
forever will it dominate your destiny.
Consume you it will, as it did Obi-Wan's apprentice.
How am I to know the good side from the bad?
when you are calm, at peace...
A Jedi uses the Force for knowledge and defense...
But tell me why I can't...
Nothing more will I teach you today.
is strong with the dark side of the Force.
A domain of evil it is.
Only what you take with you.
Bounty hunters. We don't need their scum.
Sir, we have a priority signal from the Stardestroyer Avenger.
There will be a substantial reward for the one who finds the Millennium Falcon.
You are free to use any methods necessary...
Thank goodness we're coming out of the asteroid field.
Let's get out of here. Ready for light speed?
Transfer circuits aren't working. It's not my fault.
Sir, we just lost the main rear deflector shield.
One more direct hit on the back quarter and we're done for.
Turn her around! I'm gonna put all power in the front shield.
a direct assault on an imperial Stardestroyer...
Track them. They may come around for another pass.
Captain {{14|Needa}}, the ship no longer appears on our scopes.
They can't have disappeared. No ship that small has a cloaking device.
I shall assume full responsibility for losing them and apologize to Lord {{5|Vader}}.
Meanwhile, continue to scan the area.
Oh, no. We'll never get it out now.
Always with you it cannot be done.
Hear you nothing that I say?
Master, moving stones around is one thing.
You must unlearn what you have learned.
All right. I'll give it a try.
Look at me. Judge me by my size, do you?
for my ally is the Force.
And a powerful ally it is.
Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter.
You must feel the Force around you.
even between the land and the ship.
Lord {{5|Vader}}, our ships have completed their scan and found nothing.
If the Millennium Falcon went into light speed...
it'll be on the other side of the galaxy now.
Calculate every possible destination along their last known trajectory.
Yes, my lord. We'll find them.
Alert all commands. Deploy the fleet.
Captain Solo, this time you have gone too far.
I will not be quiet, Chewbacca. Why doesn't anyone listen to me?
The fleet's beginning to break up.
Go stand by the manual release for the landing claw.
I really don't see how that's going to help.
Surrender is a perfectly acceptable alternative in extreme circumstances.
The Empire may be gracious enough...
What did you have in mind next?
If they follow standard imperial procedure...
they'll dump their garbage before they go to light speed.
With the rest of the garbage.
Then we gotta find a safe port somewhere around here.
The Anoat system. There's not much there.
{{6|Lando}}'s not a system. He's a man. {{6|Lando}} Calrissian.
Bespin. It's pretty far, but I think we can make it.
We go back a long way, {{6|Lando}} and me.
But he's got no love for the Empire. I can tell you that.
Here we go, Chewie. Stand by. Detach.
Not many of them, but you do have them.
Through the Force, things you will see.
Other places. The future. The past.
I saw a city in the clouds.
It is the future you see.
Always in motion is the future.
Decide you must how to serve them best.
If you leave now, help them you could...
but you would destroy all for which they have fought and suffered.
No, I don't have a landing permit.
Wait a minute! Let me explain!
You will not deviate from your present course.
I thought you knew this person.
That was a long time ago. I'm sure he's forgotten about that.
Permission granted to land on Platform 327.
Nothing to worry about. We go way back, {{6|Lando}} and me.
Look, don't worry. Everything's gonna be fine.
Why, you slimy, double-crossing, no-good swindler.
You've got a lot of guts coming here, after what you pulled.
How you doin', you old pirate? So good to see you!
I never thought I'd see you again.
Repairs. I thought you could help me out.
What have you done to my ship?
Hey, remember, you lost her to me fair and square.
Still hanging around with this loser?
Welcome. I'm {{6|Lando}} Calrissian. I'm the administrator of this facility.
All right, all right. You old smoothie.
Hello, sir. I am C-3PO, human-cyborg relations.
My facilities are at your... Well, really!
I'll get my people to work on her.
That ship saved my life quite a few times.
She's the fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy.
How's the gas mine? Still paying off for you?
Not as well as I'd like. We're a small outpost and not very self-sufficient.
I've had supply problems of every kind.
You sound like a businessman, a responsible leader.
Seeing you sure brings back a few things.
It's the price you pay for being successful.
Nice to see a familiar face.
That sounds like an R2 unit in there.
I didn't mean to intrude. Please don't get up.
I can't keep the vision out of my head. I've gotta help them.
But {{0|Han}} and {{3|Leia}} will die if I don't.
But I can help them. I feel the Force.
This is a dangerous time for you...
when you will be tempted by the dark side of the Force.
Yes, yes. To Obi-Wan you listen.
Remember your failure at the cave.
But I've learned so much since then.
Master {{4|Yoda}}, I promise to return and finish what I've begun.
It is you and your abilities the {{16|emperor}} wants.
That is why your friends are made to suffer.
That's why I have to go.
{{1|Luke}}, I don't want to lose you to the {{16|emperor}} the way I lost {{5|Vader}}.
Stopped they must be. On this all depends.
Only a fully trained Jedi knight, with the Force as his ally...
If you end your training now...
if you choose the quick and easy path, as {{5|Vader}} did...
you will become an agent of evil.
If you honor what they fight for...
If you choose to face {{5|Vader}}, you will do it alone.
That leads to the dark side.
Mind what you have learned. Save you it can.
Told you, I did. Reckless is he.
That boy is our last hope.
The ship's almost finished. Two or three more things and we're in great shape.
The sooner the better. Something's wrong here.
No one has seen or knows anything about 3PO.
He's been gone too long to have gotten lost.
I'll talk to {{6|Lando}} and see what I can find out.
Well, I don't trust him either, but he is my friend.
Then you're as good as gone, aren't you?
Found him in a junk pile?
What a mess. Chewie, you think you can repair him?
{{6|Lando}}'s got people that can fix him.
I'm sorry. Am I interrupting anything?
You truly belong here with us among the clouds.
Would you join me for a little refreshment?
You see, since we're a small operation...
we don't fall into the jurisdiction of the Empire.
So you're part of the Mining Guild?
Our operation is small enough not to be noticed.
since our customers are anxious to avoid attracting attention to themselves.
Aren't you afraid the Empire's gonna find out, shut you down?
It's been a danger that looms like a shadow over everything we've built.
But things have developed that'll ensure security.
I've just made a deal that'll keep the Empire out of here forever.
We would be honored if you would join us.
I had no choice. They arrived right before you did.
Just hang on. We're almost there.
I'm terribly sorry. I didn't mean to intrude.
I must tell the others. Oh, no! I've been shot!
You may take {{25|Captain}} Solo to Jabba the Hutt...
He's no good to me dead.
He will not be permanently damaged.
Lord {{5|Vader}}, what about {{3|Leia}} and the Wookiee?
They must never again leave this city.
That wasn't part of our agreement, nor was giving {{0|Han}} to this bounty hunter!
Perhaps you think you're being treated unfairly?
Good. It would be unfortunate if I had to leave a garrison here.
This deal is getting worse all the time.
Oh, yes, that's very good. I like that.
Something's not right because now I can't see.
Oh, my! What have you done?
Only an overgrown mophead like you would be stupid enough...
They never even asked me any questions.
{{5|Vader}}'s agreed to turn {{3|Leia}} and Chewie over to me.
They'll have to stay here, but they'll be safe.
{{5|Vader}}'s given him to the bounty hunter.
He doesn't want you at all.
Lord {{5|Vader}} set a trap for him.
You fixed us all real good, didn't you?
Sorry I couldn't do better, but I got my own problems.
You certainly have a way with people.
but it should be adequate to freeze Skywalker...
Good. Monitor Skywalker and allow him to land.
Lord {{5|Vader}}, we only use this facility for carbon freezing. It might kill him.
I do not want the {{16|emperor}}'s prize damaged.
We will test it on {{25|Captain}} Solo.
If you'd attached my legs I wouldn't be in this ridiculous position.
Now remember, Chewbacca, you have a responsibility for me...
You're being put into carbon freeze.
What if he doesn't survive? He's worth a lot to me.
The Empire will compensate you if he dies. Put him in.
You're going to get us all killed! Yes, stop. I'm not ready to die.
Hey, save your strength. There'll be another time.
You have to take care of her.
What's going on? Turn round. I can't see.
if he survived the freezing process, that is.
Good. See to it that he finds his way in here.
take the princess and the Wookiee to my ship.
You said they'd be left under my supervision.
I am altering the deal. Pray I don't alter it any further.
The Force is with you, young Skywalker.
But you are not a Jedi yet.
Hold them in the security tower. And keep it quiet.
What do you think you're doing?
I knew all along. It had to be a mistake.
Do you think that after what you did to {{0|Han}}...
What are you doing? Trust him!
We understand, don't we, Chewie? He had no choice.
We don't need any of your help.
There's still a chance to save {{0|Han}}...
I'm terribly sorry about all this.
After all, he's only a Wookiee.
Put {{25|Captain}} Solo in the cargo hold.
Hurry! We're trying to save {{0|Han}} from the bounty hunter.
Well, at least you're still in one piece.
Oh, no! Chewie, they're behind you!
You have learned much, young one.
You'll find I'm full of surprises.
Your destiny lies with me, Skywalker.
Obi-Wan knew this to be true.
Perhaps you're not as strong as the {{16|emperor}} thought.
Obi-Wan has taught you well. You have controlled your fear.
Only your hatred can destroy me.
The security code has been changed.
R2, you can tell the computer to override the security systems.
The Empire has taken control of the city.
I advise everyone to leave before more imperial troops arrive.
Well, don't blame me. I'm an interpreter.
I'm not supposed to know a power socket from a computer terminal.
We're not interested in the hyperdrive on the falcon. It's fixed!
Just open the door, you stupid lump!
I never doubted you for a second. Wonderful!
That hurts! Bend down, you thoughtless... Ow!
I thought that hairy beast would be the end of me.
You are beaten. It is useless to resist.
Don't let yourself be destroyed as Obi-Wan did.
You do not yet realize your importance.
You have only begun to discover your power.
and I will complete your training.
